headline: NguyenThanhNhan surges into ARC-2 gold places

sections.text: NguyenThanhNhan gained 13.89 points to reach 65.97, climbing from 28th to 14th and entering the 16 gold places.
The move lifts NguyenThanhNhan across the current gold cutoff, which stands at 65.56. The public board remains provisional.
